verdict.rationale: PagerDuty publishes an official MCP server, described as its "official local MCP server" on GitHub. It is documented in both the developer docs and the support site. It lets AI assistants such as Claude Desktop, Cursor and VS Code fetch and manage account data, supports API-token and OAuth authentication, and comes with a sample VS Code configuration; a probe confirmed the developer documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration that agents connect and work reliably via the server.
